title: The 5 Longest Undersea Cables Ever Laid, Ranked (#1 Is Longer Than Earth Is Round)

scenes.text: The five longest cables on the ocean floor. Number one is longer than the way around the Earth.

scenes.label: SEA-ME-WE 5 · 20,000 km
scenes.text: Number five: SEA-ME-WE 5. Twenty thousand kilometres between Asia and Europe, connecting 17 countries.

scenes.label: AAE-1 · 25,000 km
scenes.text: Number four: Asia Africa Europe 1. Twenty-five thousand kilometres from Hong Kong to France, by way of Egypt.

scenes.label: FLAG Europe-Asia · 28,000 km
scenes.text: Number three: FLAG Europe-Asia. Twenty-eight thousand kilometres, switched on in 1997, from Britain to Japan. Now retired.

scenes.label: SEA-ME-WE 3 · 39,000 km
scenes.text: Number two: SEA-ME-WE 3. Thirty-nine thousand kilometres, 39 landing stations in 33 countries. It held the record for over 20 years, until it retired in 2024.

scenes.label: 2Africa · 45,000 km
scenes.text: Number one: 2Africa. Forty-five thousand kilometres around the whole of Africa and on to India. Earth's circumference is about 40,000. This cable is longer.

description:
The five longest submarine cable systems ever laid, ranked by total length: 2Africa (about 45,000 km, 46 landing stations in 33 countries), SEA-ME-WE 3 (39,000 km, retired in December 2024), FLAG Europe-Asia (28,000 km, 1997, now retired), AAE-1 (25,000 km) and SEA-ME-WE 5 (20,000 km, 17 countries).
2Africa is longer than Earth's equatorial circumference of roughly 40,000 km.
Which cable carries your internet right now?
subject: undersea cable
first_comment: Did you expect a cable longer than the equator? What should we rank next?
